response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS hand, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT hand, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS sh FROM c), t AS (SELECT hand, cnt, sh, AVG(sh) OVER () AS avg_sh FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - avg_sh) AS avg_excess FROM t WHERE sh > avg_sh

assumptions.assumption: NULL and blank/whitespace-only throws values are merged into a single 'blank or missing' group.
player.player_id is unique, so the inner join does not duplicate award records.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-hand shares across all hand groups, including the blank group, computed before filtering.
